text:
mia: Quick API Q — embeddings input contract mismatch between hosted and dedicated tests. Is the canonical request shape just \"inputs: [string]\" or do we support mixed objects (\"{\\\"input\\\": ..., \\\\"id\\\": ...}\")? Also: how do we handle empty/null items and truncation warnings? PR #4823 touches this.

sam: Current contract (what runtime expects): JSON body { \"model\": string, \"inputs\": [string | {\"input\": string, \"id\": string}] }. We accept plain strings and objects with an \"input\" field. Other types are coerced to string for legacy reasons (numbers -> \"123\").

sam: Truncation: we trim by token budget per-item to the model's max_context. We do NOT throw 413 — we silently truncate and include a per-request header when any item was truncated: `X-Embed-Truncated: true`. There's also a verbose mode (`?verbose=true`) that returns `{ \"truncated\": true }` per-item in the response metadata.

jordan: fyi dedicated infra has a stricter validator that currently rejects non-string inputs (so numbers fail). That's what's breaking CI.

mia: Ok — two things we need to align: (1) validation/coercion policy, (2) empty/null behavior. Proposal: keep coercion for numbers (backcompat) but explicitly reject arrays/binary blobs. For empty/null -> return a zero vector of model-dim and add an index to `warnings` in response. Thoughts? :question:

lex: I like explicitness. Returning a zero vector avoids breaking downstream code that assumes output length == inputs length. But we must document that empty input -> zero-vector and add `warnings` top-level array with objects like `{ index: 2, reason: \"empty_input\" }`.

sam: Implementation notes: we'll (a) update JSON schema to allow string OR object with `input` key, (b) preserve number->string coercion in the parser, (c) reject Buffer/byte arrays with 400, message: \"invalid input type\", (d) when input empty/null -> compute zero vector of length N for model and add warning.

mia: Example request I'm using in tests (mixed):
```json
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-embed-1536\",
  \"inputs\": [
    \"Hello world\",
    { \"input\": \"  \", \"id\": \"slot-2\" },
    42,
    null
  ]
}
```

sam: Example response (what we'll make canonical):
```json
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-embed-1536\",
  \"vectors\": [
    { \"id\": null, \"values\": [0.003, -0.12, ...] },
    { \"id\": \"slot-2\", \"values\": [0.0, 0.0, ...] , \"meta\": { \"truncated\": false }},
    { \"id\": null, \"values\": [0.05, -0.01, ...] },
    { \"id\": null, \"values\": [0.0, 0.0, ...] }
  ],
  \"warnings\": [ { \"index\": 1, \"reason\": \"empty_input\" }, { \"index\": 3, \"reason\": \"empty_input\" } ]
}
```

jordan: Note: vector dim is model-specific. For `redwood-embed-1536` vector length=1536. Please avoid returning \"null\" vectors — use numeric zeros.

ci-bot: TEST FAILURE -> eng-platform/integration/embeds:embedding-types.test.js: line 83: expected 200 but got 400 (dedicated).

mia: @sam @jordan can one of you take PR #4823 review? It's got the validator change + a small runtime patch to emit `X-Embed-Truncated` header. CI needs the dedicated validator relaxed for coercion.

sam: I'll take it today. Quick checklist for the PR:
- update schema in runtime (allow string OR {input})
- parser: preserve numeric->string coercion
- reject binary payloads with clear error code
- add `warnings` array and `X-Embed-Truncated` header
- add unit test: mixed types -> same-length vectors, empty/null => zero-vector
- update docs + changelog

lex: I'll add an integration test in eng-platform that posts a mixed-array and asserts ordering preserved and warnings indices.

mia: Documentation note for docs team: add a short example showing `?verbose=true` to get per-item `truncated` flags. Also callout: max items per request = 1024 and per-item token limit = model max context (e.g., 8192 tokens for large models).

jordan: One more: backward compatibility decision logged in the PR description — we explicitly choose compatibility for numbers -> string, but not for objects with unknown keys.

mia: Thanks — that should unstick the tests. Sam please ping when the PR is merged and I'll update the QA matrix. :thumbsup:

sam: Will do. :eyes:
